create_simple_bandit_env: create a SimpleBandit environment with 11 arms and deterministic rewards from 0 to 1
create_bandit_with_seed: create a SimpleBandit environment with a fixed mapping_seed for reproducible arm reward assignments
run_bandit_episode: run a bandit episode by calling reset then step with an action integer from 0 to 10
review_bandit_observation_spec: review the SimpleBandit observation_spec which returns a 1x1 float32 array
summarize_bandit_regret: summarize the total_regret metric returned by bsuite_info after stepping the environment
